# Level 8 — Solution Architect

**Audience:** Senior engineers moving toward end-to-end solution design. Related track, not a mandatory step after STF.

**Graduation outcome:** Designs a complete solution connecting business requirements, applications, integrations, infrastructure, security, data, operations, delivery, and cost.

| Structured study | Recorded video | Lessons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 220–350 with extensive case-study and stakeholder practice h | 40–60 h | 100–140 |

## Capstone — Enterprise Digital Commerce Platform (`ARC-CAP`)

Complete solution architecture package for a retailer (web/mobile, inventory, payments, fulfillment, customer service, reporting, ERP integration), from requirements to executive presentation.

**Graduation gate:** Defend the solution in a simulated architecture review with competing requirements, budget constraints, changing priorities, and failure scenarios.

See [`projects/ladder.md`](../../projects/ladder.md) for the full brief and [`assessment/framework.md`](../../assessment/framework.md) for grading.
